zh.title: STAR：用于零样本HTTPS网站指纹识别的语义-流量对齐与检索
zh.abstract: 现代HTTPS机制，例如加密客户端问候 (ECH) 和加密DNS，提高了隐私性，但仍然容易受到网站指纹 (WF) 攻击，攻击者可以通过加密流量模式推断出访问的网站。现有的WF方法依赖于使用特定网站的标记流量轨迹进行监督学习，这限制了可扩展性，并且无法处理以前未见过的网站。为了解决这些限制，我们将WF重新定义为一个零样本跨模态检索问题，并引入了STAR。STAR使用双编码器架构，为加密流量轨迹和爬取时逻辑配置文件学习一个联合嵌入空间。STAR在15万个自动收集的流量-逻辑对上，采用对比和一致性目标以及结构感知增强进行训练，能够为给定轨迹检索出语义上最匹配的配置文件，且无需在训练期间提供目标侧流量。在1600个未见过网站上的实验表明，STAR在开放世界检测中实现了87.9%的top-1准确率和0.963的AUC，优于监督学习和少样本学习基线方法。额外添加一个每个网站仅用四个标记轨迹的适配器，可进一步将top-5准确率提升至98.8%。我们的分析揭示了现代网络协议中固有的语义-流量对齐性，将语义泄漏识别为加密HTTPS流量中主要的隐私风险。我们发布了STAR的数据集和代码，以支持可复现性和未来的研究。

summary.summary: STAR提出了一种零样本HTTPS网站指纹识别方法，将该问题重新定义为跨模态检索任务，旨在对齐加密流量模式与爬取时获得的语义网站配置文件。该系统在无需预先标记流量的情况下，对1,600个未见过网站的识别达到了87.87%的top-1准确率，并展示了强大的开放世界检测能力，AUC为0.963。
originalProblem: 现有监督式网站指纹识别（WF）模型面临“流量漂移”问题，由于网站内容和模式的演变，需要频繁且代价高昂的重新训练。
监督式WF方法无法泛化到未见过的网站，严重限制了它们在动态、开放世界场景中的可扩展性和适用性。
为大量网站获取大型、多样化且最新的标注流量数据集在实践中是不可行且资源密集型的。
solution: 将网站指纹识别重新定义为零样本跨模态检索问题，旨在对齐加密流量痕迹与语义网站逻辑配置文件。
采用双编码器架构，使用改进的DFNet处理流量，并使用Transformer编码器处理逻辑配置文件，将它们映射到共享的潜在空间中。
利用多目标对比训练策略（InfoNCE、监督对比和一致性损失）和结构感知跨模态增强来学习鲁棒的对齐。
keyInsights: 尽管存在先进的HTTPS机制，通过加密流量模式（特别是网站资源加载的结构特征）发生的“语义泄露”仍然是一个主要的隐私漏洞。
加密流量和语义网站配置文件表现出强大的“对齐锚点”，例如请求包长度与URI大小之间或累积响应大小与资源内容量之间的相关性。
网站指纹识别可以成功地重新定义为零样本跨模态检索任务，从而无需任何针对特定网站的预先标注流量数据即可识别网站。
results: 在零样本、封闭世界设置下，对1,600个未见过的网站实现了87.87%的top-1准确率和96.94%的top-5准确率。
每个网站仅使用四条标注痕迹（4-shot），通过使用Tip-Adapter，性能提升至93.42%的top-1准确率和98.95%的top-5准确率，超越了最先进的基线。
展示了强大的开放世界检测能力，实现了0.963的AUC和90.65的最佳F1分数，优于多个竞争基线。

zh.overview:
## 引言

网站指纹识别（WF）在加密网络流量中代表着一个重大的隐私问题，攻击者试图通过分析HTTPS流量中的模式来识别访问过的网站。传统方法依赖于使用来自目标网站的带标签流量数据进行监督学习，但这些方法在现实世界场景中面临着根本性限制，因为新网站不断涌现且流量模式随时间演变。

STAR（语义-流量对齐与检索）通过将网站指纹识别重新定义为零样本跨模态检索问题，引入了一种范式转变。STAR不需要为每个目标网站提供带标签的流量数据，而是学习将加密流量模式与在网络爬取过程中获得的网站结构的语义描述对齐。这种方法使得无需任何事先的流量收集即可识别以前未见过的网站，解决了当前WF研究中的关键可扩展性和泛化挑战。

![STAR Alignment Framework](https://paper-assets.alphaxiv.org/figures/2512.17667v1/img-0.jpeg)
*图1：STAR的核心概念，展示了网络爬取获得的语义逻辑配置文件如何通过三个关键锚点与加密流量模式对齐：请求锚点（URI长度相关性）、响应锚点（内容大小相关性）和协议锚点（HTTP版本相关性）。*

## 技术方法

STAR采用双编码器架构，将两种不同的数据模态映射到一个共享的嵌入空间中。**流量编码器**处理加密网络轨迹，而**逻辑编码器**处理在爬取过程中提取的语义网站配置文件。

### 流量表示

每个流量轨迹表示为多达5,000个数据包的序列，其中每个数据包$p_i$由三个特征表征：

$$
p_i = (\text{dir}(p_i), v_i, s_i)
$$

其中$\text{dir}(p_i)$是定向数据包长度（客户端到服务器为正，服务器到客户端为负），$v_i$表示推断的HTTP版本，$s_i$表示双向流索引。

### 逻辑配置文件构建

网站语义配置文件通过多达80个资源级特征捕获结构特性，这些特征分为以下几类：
- **标识符指标**：霍夫曼编码和原始URI长度
- **内容指标**：响应大小和头部长度
- **协议上下文**：HTTP版本、MIME类型和服务器IP索引

### 跨模态训练目标

训练采用多组件损失函数，结合了跨模态对齐和模态内判别：

$$
L = L_{\text{InfoNCE}} + \lambda_{\text{sup}} \cdot L_{\text{SupCon}} + \lambda_{\text{cons}} \cdot L_{\text{Consistency}}
$$

InfoNCE损失通过最大化匹配的流量-逻辑对之间的相似性，同时最小化不匹配对之间的相似性来驱动跨模态对齐。监督对比损失和一致性损失增强了流量模态内的可区分性，以实现更好的分类性能。

![STAR Architecture](https://paper-assets.alphaxiv.org/figures/2512.17667v1/img-1.jpeg)
*图2：STAR的双编码器架构，展示了包含三个损失组件和结构感知增强的训练过程，以提高鲁棒性。*

## 零样本和少样本推理

STAR支持多种推理模式，具体取决于可用数据：

### 零样本分类
对于完全未见过的网站，STAR对测试流量进行编码，并使用余弦相似度将其与预计算的逻辑嵌入进行比较。超过置信度阈值的网站被预测，而其他网站则被拒绝为未知。

![Zero-Shot Inference](https://paper-assets.alphaxiv.org/figures/2512.17667v1/img-2.jpeg)
*图3：零样本推理过程，其中测试流量与预计算的逻辑嵌入库进行匹配，无需任何带标签的流量数据。*

### 少样本适应
当可用的带标签流量有限时，STAR 提供两种适应策略：

**线性探测**：在冻结编码器的情况下，使用少量样本的流量嵌入训练一个轻量级线性分类器。

![线性探测](https://paper-assets.alphaxiv.org/figures/2512.17667v1/img-3.jpeg)
*图4：使用少量带标签样本进行线性探测适应，在冻结的流量嵌入之上训练分类器。*

**Tip-Adapter**：结合基于锚点的检索 logits 与来自少量样本流量记忆的 k-近邻 logits，以提高预测准确性。

![Tip-Adapter](https://paper-assets.alphaxiv.org/figures/2512.17667v1/img-4.jpeg)
*图5：Tip-Adapter 融合方法，结合零样本检索和少样本 k-NN 分类以提高性能。*

## 实证验证与性能结果

### 对齐锚点验证

研究提供了加密流量与网站语义之间三个基本对齐锚点的统计证据：

1. **请求锚点**：HTTPS 请求数据包长度与霍夫曼编码的 URI 长度之间存在强相关性（Pearson r = 0.3114, p < 0.05）
2. **响应锚点**：累积响应大小与资源内容量之间存在高度对齐（1 - Wasserstein 距离 = 0.9109, p < 0.05）
3. **协议锚点**：UDP 流量比率与 HTTP/3 服务器使用情况之间存在显著相关性（Pearson r = 0.5607, p < 0.05）

### 分类性能

STAR 在 1,600 个未见网站上展示了卓越的零样本能力：
- 零样本配置下达到 **87.87% 的 top-1 准确率** 和 **96.94% 的 top-5 准确率**
- 性能与 8 样本监督基线相当，无需任何目标站点流量

![性能比较](https://paper-assets.alphaxiv.org/figures/2512.17667v1/img-5.jpeg)
*图6：STAR 的零样本性能与少样本基线匹配或超越，展示了显著的数据效率优势。*

### 开放世界检测

在真实场景中，当未知网站与受监控网站混杂时，STAR 实现了：
- 零样本检测的 **AUC 为 0.963**
- **F1 分数为 90.65**，显著优于最先进的基线方法

![开放世界结果](https://paper-assets.alphaxiv.org/figures/2512.17667v1/img-6.jpeg)
*图7：精确率-召回率曲线显示 STAR 相较于既有基线具有卓越的开放世界检测能力。*

## 分析与可解释性

### 嵌入空间可视化

t-SNE 分析表明，STAR 在共享嵌入空间中学习到良好分离的、跨模态对齐的聚类，与基线方法相比，类内分组更紧密。

![基线 t-SNE](https://paper-assets.alphaxiv.org/figures/2512.17667v1/img-7.jpeg)
*图8：基线方法的 t-SNE 可视化显示聚类松散，跨模态对齐不良。*

![STAR t-SNE](https://paper-assets.alphaxiv.org/figures/2512.17667v1/img-8.jpeg)
*图9：STAR 的嵌入空间展示了紧密、良好分离的聚类，流量和逻辑模态之间具有强大的跨模态对齐。*

### 特征归因分析

基于梯度的分析显示 STAR 专注于局部判别模式：
- 逻辑配置文件中的早期资源槽位（前20个资源）
- 流量跟踪中的初始数据包组（前20个数据包）

![特征归因](https://paper-assets.alphaxiv.org/figures/2512.17667v1/img-9.jpeg)
*图10：梯度归因揭示 STAR 专注于两种模态中的早期判别特征。*

### 扩展行为

训练数据分析揭示了高效的学习特性：
- 零样本准确率在大约 100,000 个跨模态样本后达到饱和
- 随着训练数据规模的充足，top-1 准确率达到 95%

![扩展分析](https://paper-assets.alphaxiv.org/figures/2512.17667v1/img-10.jpeg)
*图11：STAR 的性能随训练数据有效扩展，在大约 10 万个样本后达到饱和。*

## 意义与影响

STAR 从根本上推进了网站指纹识别研究，通过证明尽管存在现代加密协议，**语义泄漏**依然持续存在。尽管像加密客户端问候 (ECH) 和加密DNS这样的技术保护了传统标识符，但通过流量分析，网页资源加载的结构模式仍然可以被观察到。

零样本能力消除了持续流量收集和模型再训练的需要，使得大规模网站监控变得切实可行得多。这对隐私研究和防御开发都产生了深远的影响，因为它揭示了当前的加密方法主要解决了报头可见性，却让语义信息模式暴露无遗。

从防御角度来看，STAR 的研究结果表明，有效的隐私保护需要解决流量模式和网站结构之间根本的**对齐锚点**，可能通过混淆资源加载模式、URI 长度分布或HTTP版本使用等技术，而不是简单地随机化数据包大小。

STAR-200K 数据集和实现的发布为可复现研究和持续创新提供了宝贵的资源，无论是在网站指纹识别攻击还是相应的隐私增强防御方面。

citations.title: 深度指纹：借助深度学习瓦解网站指纹识别防御

abstract: Modern HTTPS mechanisms such as Encrypted Client Hello (ECH) and encrypted DNS improve privacy but remain vulnerable to website fingerprinting (WF) attacks, where adversaries infer visited sites from encrypted traffic patterns. Existing WF methods rely on supervised learning with site-specific labeled traces, which limits scalability and fails to handle previously unseen websites. We address these limitations by reformulating WF as a zero-shot cross-modal retrieval problem and introducing STAR. STAR learns a joint embedding space for encrypted traffic traces and crawl-time logic profiles using a dual-encoder architecture. Trained on 150K automatically collected traffic-logic pairs with contrastive and consistency objectives and structure-aware augmentation, STAR retrieves the most semantically aligned profile for a trace without requiring target-side traffic during training. Experiments on 1,600 unseen websites show that STAR achieves 87.9 percent top-1 accuracy and 0.963 AUC in open-world detection, outperforming supervised and few-shot baselines. Adding an adapter with only four labeled traces per site further boosts top-5 accuracy to 98.8 percent. Our analysis reveals intrinsic semantic-traffic alignment in modern web protocols, identifying semantic leakage as the dominant privacy risk in encrypted HTTPS traffic. We release STAR's datasets and code to support reproducibility and future research.

abstract: Marketing and product personalisation provide a prominent and visible use-case for the application of Information Retrieval methods across several business domains. Recently, agentic approaches to these problems have been gaining traction. This work evaluates the behavioural and retention effects of agentic personalisation on a financial service application's customer communication system during a 2025 national tax filing period. Through a two month-long randomised controlled trial, we compare an agentic messaging approach against a business-as-usual (BAU) rule-based campaign system, focusing on two primary outcomes: unsubscribe behaviour and conversion timing. Empirical results show that agent-led messaging reduced unsubscribe events by 21\% ($\pm 0.01$) relative to BAU and increased early filing behaviour in the weeks preceding the national deadline. These findings demonstrate how adaptive, user-level decision-making systems can modulate engagement intensity whilst improving long-term retention indicators.
title: Behavioural Effects of Agentic Messaging: A Case Study on a Financial Service Application

abstract: In sequential recommendation (SR), the self-attention mechanism of Transformer-based models acts as a low-pass filter, limiting their ability to capture high-frequency signals that reflect short-term user interests. To overcome this, BSARec augments the Transformer encoder with a frequency layer that rescales high-frequency components using the Fourier transform. However, the overall effectiveness of BSARec and the roles of its individual components have yet to be systematically validated. We reproduce BSARec and show that it outperforms other SR methods on some datasets. To empirically assess whether BSARec improves performance on high-frequency signals, we propose a metric to quantify user history frequency and evaluate SR methods across different user groups. We compare digital signal processing (DSP) techniques and find that the discrete wavelet transform (DWT) offer only slight improvements over Fourier transforms, and DSP methods provide no clear advantage over simple residual connections. Finally, we explore padding strategies and find that non-constant padding significantly improves recommendation performance, whereas constant padding hinders the frequency rescaler's ability to capture high-frequency signals.
title: A Systematic Reproducibility Study of BSARec for Sequential Recommendation

abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown potential in recommendation systems (RecSys) by using them as either knowledge enhancer or zero-shot ranker. A key challenge lies in the large semantic gap between LLMs and RecSys where the former internalizes language world knowledge while the latter captures personalized world of behaviors. Unfortunately, the research community lacks a comprehensive benchmark that evaluates the LLMs over their limitations and boundaries in RecSys so that we can draw a confident conclusion. To investigate this, we propose a benchmark named LRWorld containing over 38K high-quality samples and 23M tokens carefully compiled and generated from widely used public recommendation datasets. LRWorld categorizes the mental world of LLMs in RecSys as three main scales (association, personalization, and knowledgeability) spanned by ten factors with 31 measures (tasks). Based on LRWorld, comprehensive experiments on dozens of LLMs show that they are still not well capturing the deep neural personalized embeddings but can achieve good results on shallow memory-based item-item similarity. They are also good at perceiving item entity relations, entity hierarchical taxonomies, and item-item association rules when inferring user interests. Furthermore, LLMs show a promising ability in multimodal knowledge reasoning (movie poster and product image) and robustness to noisy profiles. None of them show consistently good performance over the ten factors. Model sizes, position bias, and more are ablated.
title: The Mental World of Large Language Models in Recommendation: A Benchmark on Association, Personalization, and Knowledgeability

en.title: Warmer for Less: A Cost-Efficient Strategy for Cold-Start Recommendations at Pinterest
en.abstract: Pinterest is a leading visual discovery platform where recommender systems (RecSys) are key to delivering relevant, engaging, and fresh content to our users. In this paper, we study the problem of improving RecSys model predictions for cold-start (CS) items, which appear infrequently in the training data. Although this problem is well-studied in academia, few studies have addressed its root causes effectively at the scale of a platform like Pinterest. By investigating live traffic data, we identified several challenges of the CS problem and developed a corresponding solution for each: First, industrial-scale RecSys models must operate under tight computational constraints. Since CS items are a minority, any related improvements must be highly cost-efficient. To address this, our solutions were designed to be lightweight, collectively increasing the total parameters by only 5%. Second, CS items are represented only by non-historical (e.g., content or attribute) features, which models often treat as less important. To elevate their significance, we introduce a residual connection for the non-historical features. Third, CS items tend to receive lower prediction scores compared to non-CS items, reducing their likelihood of being surfaced. We mitigate this by incorporating a score regularization term into the model. Fourth, the labels associated with CS items are sparse, making it difficult for the model to learn from them. We apply the manifold mixup technique to address this data sparsity. Implemented together, our methods increased fresh content engagement at Pinterest by 10% without negatively impacting overall engagement and cost, and have been deployed to serve over 570 million users on Pinterest.

summary.summary: Researchers at Pinterest developed a cost-efficient, multi-pronged framework to improve recommendations for cold-start (fresh) items. This framework, which integrates residual connections, score regularization, and manifold mixup, achieved a 9.68% lift in fresh Pin grid-clicks and a 9.62% lift in saves in live A/B tests on the Pinterest platform, with minimal additional computational cost.
originalProblem: Recommender systems struggle with cold-start items (e.g., fresh content) due to a lack of historical interaction data, leading to poor recommendations and reduced discoverability.
Existing large-scale production models at Pinterest underutilize non-historical features for cold-start items and systematically assign them lower predicted scores, perpetuating the cold-start cycle.

Many academic solutions to the cold-start problem are computationally expensive or significantly increase model parameters, making them impractical for deployment in resource-constrained industrial environments.
solution: Introduced a residual connection for non-historical features to ensure their direct and substantial influence on final prediction scores, mitigating their underutilization.
Incorporated a score regularization term, using Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD) loss, to minimize the prediction score disparity between warm and cold instances, debiasing the model's output.
Applied a data-agnostic augmentation technique, inspired by manifold mixup, at the embedding space level to promote generalization and improve learning from sparse cold-start data.
keyInsights: Non-historical features receive smaller gradients than historical features, indicating models prioritize historical signals and underserve new content unless explicitly re-weighted or re-routed.
Recommender models exhibit a systematic prediction bias, consistently assigning lower scores to cold-start items, which necessitates score-level regularization to ensure fairness.

Augmenting the embedding space through techniques like manifold mixup can increase the effective rank of feature representations, leading to better generalization and reducing reliance on "shortcut" features for cold-start items.
results: The combined framework delivered a +9.68% lift in fresh Pins grid-clicks and a +9.62% lift in fresh Pins saves during large-scale online A/B tests on Pinterest.
These performance gains were achieved with minimal computational overhead, specifically a less than 5% increase in model parameters and no impact on serving costs or latency.

The solution also demonstrated increased discoverability of fresh content (e.g., up to +3.34% unique fresh Pins with 10+ impressions) and improved engagement metrics for cold-start users without negative impact on overall platform engagement.

en.overview:
## Background and Problem Context

The cold-start problem represents one of the most persistent challenges in recommender systems, particularly for platforms operating at massive scale. When items have little to no interaction history, traditional collaborative filtering approaches struggle to generate meaningful recommendations. At Pinterest, a visual discovery platform with over 570 million users and 1.5 billion Pins saved weekly, this challenge is especially pronounced for fresh content that lacks the engagement signals needed for effective recommendation.

![Challenges and Solutions Overview](https://paper-assets.alphaxiv.org/figures/2512.17277v1/img-0.jpeg)

The authors identify three fundamental challenges that perpetuate the cold-start problem in production systems: limited computational budgets that constrain solution deployment, data sparsity for cold items that limits model learning, and systematic bias where models under-predict engagement scores for cold items. Their analysis reveals that cold items primarily rely on non-historical features (content attributes), but production models learn to treat these features as less important than historical engagement signals, creating a vicious cycle where cold items remain under-recommended.

## Root Cause Analysis Through Data Investigation

The research team conducted a comprehensive analysis of Pinterest's production system to understand why cold-start items perform poorly. Their investigation revealed several critical insights about model behavior and data characteristics.

Through gradient analysis, they discovered that non-historical features consistently received smaller gradients during training compared to historical features. This mathematical evidence demonstrates that the model systematically undervalues content-based signals that are crucial for cold-start recommendations. The ratio of gradient norms between non-historical and historical features remained consistently low throughout training, indicating persistent underutilization of available content information.

The team also quantified prediction bias by analyzing score distributions for cold versus warm items. They found that cold items with positive labels received prediction scores 8-14% lower than their warm counterparts across different engagement types. This systematic underestimation directly translates to reduced visibility in ranking, perpetuating the cold-start cycle.

## Methodology: A Multi-Pronged Cost-Efficient Framework

The authors propose three complementary solutions, each targeting specific root causes while maintaining strict cost efficiency requirements for industrial deployment.

### Residual Connections for Non-Historical Features

To address the underutilization of non-historical features, the authors introduce residual connections that allow content-based features to bypass the main interaction module and directly influence final predictions. The modified architecture changes from:

$$
\hat{y} = F(I([x_h; x_{nh}]))
$$

to:

$$
\hat{y} = F(z; x_{nh})
$$

where $z = I([x_h; x_{nh}])$ and $x_{nh}$ represents non-historical features that now have a direct path to the output.

This architectural modification ensures that content features maintain strong influence on predictions regardless of how the interaction module processes historical signals. The approach adds less than 5% to model parameters, significantly more efficient than adding separate embedding towers which would increase parameters by over 28%.

### Score Regularization for Bias Mitigation

To combat systematic prediction bias, the authors incorporate Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD) loss into the training objective. This regularization term minimizes the discrepancy between average prediction scores for warm and cold items:

$$
L_{MMD} = \left\| \mathbb{E}_{\hat{y} \sim D_w}[\hat{y}] - \mathbb{E}_{\hat{y} \sim D_c}[\hat{y}] \right\|^2
$$

where $D_w$ and $D_c$ represent distributions of warm and cold items respectively. This approach directly addresses the identified score bias without adding any trainable parameters or serving costs.

### Manifold Mixup for Improved Generalization

To enhance model generalization and reduce over-reliance on historical shortcuts, the authors apply manifold mixup at the embedding level. This technique creates interpolated training examples:

$$
z_{mixed} = \lambda \cdot z_i + (1 - \lambda) \cdot z_j
$$

$$
y_{mixed} = \lambda \cdot y_i + (1 - \lambda) \cdot y_j
$$

By training on these interpolated instances, the model learns smoother decision boundaries and becomes less dependent on dominant historical signals. This data-agnostic augmentation operates directly on feature vectors, incurring minimal computational overhead while encouraging more robust representations.

The complete training objective combines these components:

$$
L_{final} = L_{BCE}(\hat{y}, y) + \lambda_1 L_{BCE}(\hat{y}_{mix}, y_{mix}) + \lambda_2 L_{MMD}(\hat{y}, y)
$$

## Experimental Results and Validation

### Offline Performance Analysis

The authors evaluated their methods using Pinterest's multi-task ranking model, measuring Hits@3 for grid-click and save actions on fresh Pins (content created within 28 days) as primary cold-start metrics.

Individual method performance demonstrated significant improvements:
- **Residual connections**: +1.32% fresh Pins grid-click, +1.61% save with only 4.96% parameter increase
- **Score regularization**: +1.59% fresh Pins grid-click, +1.75% save with zero parameter increase
- **Manifold mixup**: +2.03% fresh Pins grid-click, +1.42% save with zero parameter increase

The combined approach achieved the strongest offline results: +3.20% fresh Pins grid-click and +3.40% fresh Pins save, while maintaining neutral impact on overall metrics. This demonstrates the methods' ability to improve cold-start performance without sacrificing warm item recommendations.

Mechanistic analysis validated the theoretical foundations. Residual connections increased the importance of non-historical features, as evidenced by left-shifted feature importance distributions and higher gradient ratios. Score regularization successfully narrowed prediction gaps, reducing the disparity for positive grid-clicks from 13.65% to 0.53%. Manifold mixup increased embedding space rank and distributed explained variance more evenly across principal components, indicating improved generalization.

### Large-Scale Online A/B Testing

The framework's real-world effectiveness was validated through A/B tests involving approximately 12 million users per group on Pinterest's Related Pins surface. The results exceeded offline expectations:

- **Combined solution**: +9.68% fresh Pins grid-clicks, +9.62% fresh Pins saves
- **Overall impact**: Neutral to slightly positive on all Pins metrics (+0.26% grid-click, -0.32% save)

The online results demonstrate successful translation of offline improvements to production environments. Individual methods showed strong performance (2.5% to 7.9% improvements on fresh content), with the combined approach achieving nearly 10% improvements in cold-start engagement.

Additional analyses revealed broader ecosystem benefits. The number of unique fresh Pins receiving significant engagement (10+ impressions or saves) increased by 1.5% to 8%, indicating improved content discoverability. Cold-start users experienced significant improvements in successful sessions, grid-click sessions, and save sessions, with positive effects extending to upstream surfaces like Homefeed and Search.

## Technical Contributions and Practical Impact

### Cost-Efficiency and Scalability

The framework's primary technical contribution lies in achieving substantial cold-start improvements while maintaining strict cost constraints. With less than 5% parameter increase and zero serving cost impact, the solution addresses a critical barrier to industrial deployment. Previous approaches often required separate model towers, complex auxiliary tasks, or significant computational overhead that made them impractical for production systems.

### Plug-and-Play Architecture

The methods integrate seamlessly with existing ranking architectures without requiring fundamental redesign. This modularity enables rapid adoption across different platforms and model types, significantly lowering implementation barriers. The framework-agnostic design means teams can implement these techniques without extensive infrastructure changes.

### Systematic Problem Decomposition

Rather than proposing a single monolithic solution, the authors systematically address distinct aspects of the cold-start problem. This decomposition allows for targeted interventions and provides insights into which mechanisms drive improvements. The approach offers flexibility for platforms to adopt components based on their specific constraints and requirements.

## Broader Implications for Recommender Systems

This work bridges the gap between academic cold-start research and practical industrial deployment. Many existing solutions, while theoretically sound, face adoption barriers due to computational costs or architectural complexity. By demonstrating that significant improvements are achievable within realistic constraints, the research provides a roadmap for industry practitioners facing similar challenges.

The framework also addresses fairness and ecosystem health concerns. Cold-start bias disproportionately affects new creators, merchants, and diverse content, potentially reinforcing popularity biases. By improving fresh content discoverability, the solution promotes a more equitable platform where new participants can gain traction more effectively.

The validation methodology, combining offline analysis with large-scale online testing, establishes best practices for evaluating recommender system improvements. The mechanistic analysis providing evidence for why methods work (gradient analysis, score distribution analysis, embedding space analysis) offers valuable insights for future research.

The positive impact on cold-start users and the spillover effects to upstream surfaces demonstrate how targeted improvements can create beneficial feedback loops throughout recommendation ecosystems. As these users develop richer interaction histories through improved initial experiences, the overall system benefits from enhanced user modeling and engagement patterns.

zh.title: 低成本预热：Pinterest冷启动推荐的经济高效策略
zh.abstract:
**Pinterest 是一个领先的视觉发现平台，推荐系统 (RecSys) 对于向用户提供相关、引人入胜且新鲜的内容至关重要。本文研究了如何改进推荐系统模型对冷启动 (CS) 物品的预测问题。这类物品在训练数据中出现的频率较低。尽管该问题在学术界已得到充分研究，但在 Pinterest 这样规模的平台上，鲜有研究能有效解决其根本原因。通过调查实时流量数据，我们识别出冷启动问题的若干挑战，并针对每个挑战开发了相应的解决方案：**

**首先，工业级推荐系统模型必须在严苛的计算约束下运行。由于冷启动物品是少数，任何相关改进都必须具备高成本效益。为此，我们的解决方案被设计为轻量级，总参数仅增加了 5%。**

**其次，冷启动物品仅通过非历史（例如内容或属性）特征表示，模型通常会认为这些特征不那么重要。为了提升它们的显著性，我们为非历史特征引入了残差连接。**

**第三，与非冷启动物品相比，冷启动物品往往获得较低的预测分数，从而降低了它们被展示的可能性。我们通过在模型中引入分数正则化项来缓解这一问题。**

**第四，与冷启动物品相关的标签稀疏，导致模型难以从中学习。我们应用流形混合 (manifold mixup) 技术来解决这一数据稀疏性问题。**

**这些方法协同实施后，使 Pinterest 的新鲜内容互动量增加了 10%，同时没有对整体互动量和成本造成负面影响，并已部署为 Pinterest 超过 5.7 亿用户提供服务。**

summary.summary: Pinterest 的研究人员开发了一个具有成本效益的多管齐下框架，旨在改善冷启动（新）商品的推荐。该框架整合了残差连接、分数正则化和流形混合，在 Pinterest 平台上的实时 A/B 测试中，使新 Pin 图的网格点击率提升了 9.68%，保存率提升了 9.62%，同时计算成本增加极小。
originalProblem: 推荐系统在处理冷启动商品（例如新内容）时面临困难，因为缺乏历史交互数据，导致推荐效果不佳和可发现性降低。
Pinterest 现有的规模化生产模型未充分利用冷启动商品的非历史特征，并系统性地为其分配较低的预测分数，从而使冷启动循环持续存在。
许多针对冷启动问题的学术解决方案计算成本高昂或显著增加模型参数，使其在资源受限的工业环境中不切实际。
solution: 引入了非历史特征的残差连接，以确保它们对最终预测分数产生直接和实质性影响，从而减轻其未充分利用的问题。
结合了分数正则化项，使用最大均值差异（MMD）损失，以最小化热启动和冷启动实例之间的预测分数差异，从而消除模型的偏差。
在嵌入空间级别应用了一种数据无关的增强技术，灵感来自流形混合，以促进泛化并改善从稀疏冷启动数据中学习的效果。
keyInsights: 非历史特征获得的梯度小于历史特征，这表明模型优先考虑历史信号，除非明确重新加权或重新路由，否则会低估新内容。
推荐模型表现出系统性的预测偏差，始终为冷启动商品分配较低分数，这需要分数级别的正则化以确保公平性。
通过流形混合等技术增强嵌入空间可以增加特征表示的有效秩，从而实现更好的泛化，并减少对冷启动商品“捷径”特征的依赖。
results: 该组合框架在 Pinterest 的大规模在线 A/B 测试中，使新 Pin 图的网格点击率提升了 +9.68%，新 Pin 图的保存率提升了 +9.62%。
这些性能提升是在计算开销极小的情况下实现的，具体来说，模型参数增加了不到 5%，并且对服务成本或延迟没有影响。
该解决方案还展示了新内容的可发现性提高（例如，获得 10 次以上曝光的独特新 Pin 图增加了多达 +3.34%），并改善了冷启动用户的参与度指标，同时未对整体平台参与度产生负面影响。

zh.overview:
## 背景与问题背景

冷启动问题是推荐系统中最持久的挑战之一，尤其对于大规模运行的平台更是如此。当项目几乎没有交互历史时，传统的协同过滤方法难以生成有意义的推荐。在 Pinterest 这个拥有超过 5.7 亿用户和每周保存 15 亿个 Pin 的视觉发现平台，新内容由于缺乏有效推荐所需的参与度信号，这一挑战尤为突出。

![挑战与解决方案概述](https://paper-assets.alphaxiv.org/figures/2512.17277v1/img-0.jpeg)

作者们指出了在生产系统中造成冷启动问题的三个基本挑战：限制解决方案部署的计算预算有限、冷门项目数据稀疏限制模型学习，以及模型系统性地低估冷门项目的参与度得分所导致的系统偏差。他们的分析表明，冷门项目主要依赖非历史特征（内容属性），但生产模型却学会将这些特征视为不如历史参与度信号重要，从而形成一个恶性循环，导致冷门项目持续未得到充分推荐。

## 通过数据调查进行的根本原因分析

研究团队对 Pinterest 的生产系统进行了全面分析，以了解冷启动项目表现不佳的原因。他们的调查揭示了关于模型行为和数据特征的几个关键见解。

通过梯度分析，他们发现非历史特征在训练过程中始终比历史特征获得更小的梯度。这一数学证据表明，模型系统性地低估了对冷启动推荐至关重要的基于内容的信号。在整个训练过程中，非历史特征与历史特征之间的梯度范数比率始终保持在较低水平，这表明对可用内容信息的持续未充分利用。

团队还通过分析冷门与热门项目的分数分布来量化预测偏差。他们发现，对于不同参与类型，带有正标签的冷门项目获得的预测分数比其热门同类项目低 8-14%。这种系统性低估直接导致排名可见度降低，从而使冷启动循环持续存在。

## 方法论：一个多管齐下且成本效益高的框架

作者提出了三种互补的解决方案，每种方案都针对特定的根本原因，同时满足工业部署对严格成本效益的要求。

### 非历史特征的残差连接

为了解决非历史特征的未充分利用问题，作者引入了残差连接，允许基于内容的特征绕过主要交互模块，直接影响最终预测。修改后的架构从：

$$
\hat{y} = F(I([x_h; x_{nh}]))
$$

变为：

$$
\hat{y} = F(z; x_{nh})
$$

其中 $z = I([x_h; x_{nh}])$，$x_{nh}$ 代表现在可以直接通往输出的非历史特征。

这种架构修改确保了内容特征无论交互模块如何处理历史信号，都能对预测保持强烈影响。该方法使模型参数增加不到 5%，比添加单独的嵌入塔（这将使参数增加超过 28%）效率显著更高。

### 用于偏差缓解的分数正则化

为了对抗系统性预测偏差，作者将最大平均差异（MMD）损失纳入训练目标。该正则化项最小化热门和冷门项目平均预测分数之间的差异：

$$
L_{MMD} = \left\| \mathbb{E}_{\hat{y} \sim D_w}[\hat{y}] - \mathbb{E}_{\hat{y} \sim D_c}[\hat{y}] \right\|^2
$$

其中 $D_w$ 和 $D_c$ 分别代表热门和冷门商品的分布。这种方法直接解决了识别出的分数偏差，而无需增加任何可训练参数或服务成本。

### 流形混合以提高泛化能力

为了增强模型的泛化能力并减少对历史捷径的过度依赖，作者在嵌入层应用了流形混合。该技术创建了插值训练样本：

$$
z_{mixed} = \lambda \cdot z_i + (1 - \lambda) \cdot z_j
$$

$$
y_{mixed} = \lambda \cdot y_i + (1 - \lambda) \cdot y_j
$$

通过对这些插值实例进行训练，模型学习到更平滑的决策边界，并减少对主导历史信号的依赖。这种数据无关的增强直接作用于特征向量，带来了最小的计算开销，同时鼓励了更鲁棒的表示。

完整的训练目标结合了这些组件：

$$
L_{final} = L_{BCE}(\hat{y}, y) + \lambda_1 L_{BCE}(\hat{y}_{mix}, y_{mix}) + \lambda_2 L_{MMD}(\hat{y}, y)
$$

## 实验结果与验证

### 离线性能分析

作者使用Pinterest的多任务排名模型评估了他们的方法，将新鲜Pins（28天内创建的内容）的网格点击和保存动作的Hits@3作为主要的冷启动指标。

各个方法的性能均表现出显著改进：
- **残差连接**：新鲜Pins网格点击增加+1.32%，保存增加+1.61%，参数仅增加4.96%
- **分数正则化**：新鲜Pins网格点击增加+1.59%，保存增加+1.75%，参数零增加
- **流形混合**：新鲜Pins网格点击增加+2.03%，保存增加+1.42%，参数零增加

组合方法取得了最强的离线结果：新鲜Pins网格点击增加+3.20%，新鲜Pins保存增加+3.40%，同时对整体指标保持中性影响。这表明这些方法能够在不牺牲热门商品推荐的情况下改善冷启动性能。

机制分析验证了理论基础。残差连接增加了非历史特征的重要性，表现为特征重要性分布左移和更高的梯度比。分数正则化成功缩小了预测差距，将正向网格点击的差异从13.65%降低到0.53%。流形混合增加了嵌入空间的秩，并更均匀地分配了解释方差，表明泛化能力有所提高。

### 大规模在线A/B测试

该框架的实际效果通过在Pinterest相关Pins页面上对每组约1200万用户进行的A/B测试得到了验证。结果超出了离线预期：

- **组合解决方案**：新鲜Pins网格点击增加+9.68%，新鲜Pins保存增加+9.62%
- **整体影响**：对所有Pins指标呈中性或略微积极（网格点击增加+0.26%，保存减少-0.32%）

在线结果表明，离线改进成功转化到了生产环境。单个方法表现出强大的性能（新鲜内容改进2.5%至7.9%），而组合方法在冷启动参与度方面实现了近10%的改进。

额外分析揭示了更广泛的生态系统效益。获得显著互动（10次以上展示或保存）的独特新鲜Pins数量增加了1.5%至8%，表明内容可发现性得到改善。冷启动用户在成功会话、网格点击会话和保存会话方面经历了显著改进，积极影响甚至延伸到Homefeed和搜索等上游页面。

## 技术贡献与实际影响

### 成本效益与可扩展性

该框架的主要技术贡献在于，在严格的成本限制下，实现了冷启动性能的显著提升。在参数增加不到5%且服务成本无影响的情况下，该解决方案解决了工业部署的关键障碍。以往的方法通常需要独立的模型塔、复杂的辅助任务或巨大的计算开销，这使得它们在生产系统中不切实际。

### 即插即用架构

这些方法与现有排序架构无缝集成，无需进行根本性的重新设计。这种模块化特性使得它们能够快速应用于不同的平台和模型类型，显著降低了实施障碍。与框架无关的设计意味着团队无需进行大规模基础设施改造即可实施这些技术。

### 系统性问题分解

作者没有提出单一的整体解决方案，而是系统地解决了冷启动问题的不同方面。这种分解允许有针对性的干预，并提供了哪些机制推动改进的见解。该方法为平台提供了灵活性，使其可以根据自身的具体约束和要求采用不同的组件。

## 对推荐系统的更广泛影响

这项工作弥合了学术冷启动研究与实际工业部署之间的鸿沟。许多现有解决方案虽然在理论上是健全的，但由于计算成本或架构复杂性而面临采用障碍。通过证明在现实约束下可以实现显著改进，这项研究为面临类似挑战的行业从业者提供了路线图。

该框架还解决了公平性和生态系统健康问题。冷启动偏差对新创作者、商家和多样化内容造成不成比例的影响，可能加剧流行度偏差。通过提高新鲜内容的发现能力，该解决方案促进了一个更公平的平台，新参与者可以在其中更有效地获得关注。

结合离线分析和大规模在线测试的验证方法，为评估推荐系统改进建立了最佳实践。提供方法工作原理（梯度分析、分数分布分析、嵌入空间分析）证据的机制分析为未来的研究提供了宝贵的见解。

对冷启动用户的积极影响以及对上游界面的溢出效应表明，有针对性的改进如何在整个推荐生态系统中产生有益的反馈循环。随着这些用户通过改善的初始体验积累更丰富的交互历史，整个系统将受益于增强的用户建模和参与模式。

abstract: Pinterest is a leading visual discovery platform where recommender systems (RecSys) are key to delivering relevant, engaging, and fresh content to our users. In this paper, we study the problem of improving RecSys model predictions for cold-start (CS) items, which appear infrequently in the training data. Although this problem is well-studied in academia, few studies have addressed its root causes effectively at the scale of a platform like Pinterest. By investigating live traffic data, we identified several challenges of the CS problem and developed a corresponding solution for each: First, industrial-scale RecSys models must operate under tight computational constraints. Since CS items are a minority, any related improvements must be highly cost-efficient. To address this, our solutions were designed to be lightweight, collectively increasing the total parameters by only 5%. Second, CS items are represented only by non-historical (e.g., content or attribute) features, which models often treat as less important. To elevate their significance, we introduce a residual connection for the non-historical features. Third, CS items tend to receive lower prediction scores compared to non-CS items, reducing their likelihood of being surfaced. We mitigate this by incorporating a score regularization term into the model. Fourth, the labels associated with CS items are sparse, making it difficult for the model to learn from them. We apply the manifold mixup technique to address this data sparsity. Implemented together, our methods increased fresh content engagement at Pinterest by 10% without negatively impacting overall engagement and cost, and have been deployed to serve over 570 million users on Pinterest.

en.title: Mindscape-Aware Retrieval Augmented Generation for Improved Long Context Understanding
en.abstract: Humans understand long and complex texts by relying on a holistic semantic representation of the content. This global view helps organize prior knowledge, interpret new information, and integrate evidence dispersed across a document, as revealed by the Mindscape-Aware Capability of humans in psychology. Current Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems lack such guidance and therefore struggle with long-context tasks. In this paper, we propose Mindscape-Aware RAG (MiA-RAG), the first approach that equips LLM-based RAG systems with explicit global context awareness. MiA-RAG builds a mindscape through hierarchical summarization and conditions both retrieval and generation on this global semantic representation. This enables the retriever to form enriched query embeddings and the generator to reason over retrieved evidence within a coherent global context. We evaluate MiA-RAG across diverse long-context and bilingual benchmarks for evidence-based understanding and global sense-making. It consistently surpasses baselines, and further analysis shows that it aligns local details with a coherent global representation, enabling more human-like long-context retrieval and reasoning.

summary.summary: Researchers from the Chinese Academy of Sciences and WeChat AI developed Mindscape-Aware RAG (MiA-RAG), integrating a global semantic "mindscape" into retrieval and generation for long-context understanding. MiA-RAG achieves absolute performance gains of up to 16.18% over vanilla baselines on diverse benchmarks, allowing smaller models to outperform much larger traditional RAG systems.
originalProblem: Large Language Models (LLMs) have limited context windows, hindering their ability to process and reason over very long documents.
Existing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems operate primarily on local evidence, lacking a holistic, global semantic understanding of the entire document.
This absence of a "mindscape-aware capability" in RAG leads to struggles in integrating dispersed evidence and interpreting information within a broader document context.
solution: A hierarchical "Mindscape" is constructed for each long document using a two-step GPT-4o summarization process to create a global semantic representation.
MiA-Emb, a Mindscape-Aware Retriever, enriches query embeddings by integrating the global Mindscape through a residual connection and is trained with joint contrastive optimization.
MiA-Gen, a Mindscape-Aware Generator, is fine-tuned to condition its generation on the global Mindscape and retrieved chunks, enabling integrative reasoning.
keyInsights: Equipping RAG systems with a "Mindscape-Aware Capability" (a global semantic representation inspired by human cognition) significantly enhances long-context understanding.
Integrating global semantics directly into the query representation, rather to merely enriching document chunks, enables more precise and selective retrieval.
Explicitly conditioning both the retriever (MiA-Emb) and generator (MiA-Gen) on the same global "Mindscape" fosters cohesive understanding and integrative reasoning.
results: MiA-RAG consistently achieved top performance across five diverse long-context and bilingual benchmarks, showing absolute gains of up to 16.18% over vanilla 14B and 8.63% over vanilla 72B baselines.

Smaller MiA-RAG components, such as MiA-Emb-0.6B and MiA-Gen-14B, matched or exceeded the performance of significantly larger vanilla models, indicating efficiency and better long-context understanding through global semantics.

Internal analysis confirmed that MiA-Emb guides queries to semantically relevant regions (37.1° projection angle vs. 43.5° for vanilla), and MiA-Gen demonstrates higher Mindscape-Coherent Evidence Alignment for integrative reasoning.

en.overview:
## Background and Motivation

Current Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems face a fundamental limitation when processing long, complex documents. While these systems can retrieve relevant text chunks and generate responses based on local evidence, they lack what the authors term "Mindscape-Aware Capability" - the human cognitive ability to maintain a holistic understanding of an entire document's semantic structure. This limitation becomes particularly problematic when questions require integrating information scattered across different sections or understanding the global context of a narrative.

![Comparison of Standard RAG and Mindscape-Aware RAG approaches](https://paper-assets.alphaxiv.org/figures/2512.17220v1/img-1.jpeg)

The paper introduces Mindscape-Aware Retrieval Augmented Generation (MiA-RAG), a framework that explicitly incorporates global semantic understanding into both the retrieval and generation stages of RAG systems. Drawing inspiration from psychological theories such as schema theory and the Fuzzy-Trace Theory, MiA-RAG aims to bridge the gap between human cognitive processes and artificial intelligence systems for long-context understanding.

## Core Architecture and Methodology

MiA-RAG consists of three main components that work together to enable global context awareness: hierarchical mindscape construction, a mindscape-aware retriever (MiA-Emb), and a mindscape-aware generator (MiA-Gen).

### Mindscape Construction

The "mindscape" serves as an explicit global memory representation of the entire document. It is constructed through a two-stage hierarchical summarization process using a powerful language model (GPT-4o):

1. **Chunk-Level Summarization**: Each document chunk is individually summarized to create concise, focused summaries that retain key information while filtering out irrelevant details.

2. **Global Summarization**: All chunk-level summaries are concatenated and further condensed into a single coherent representation that captures the document's overarching themes and structure.

This hierarchical approach ensures that the mindscape contains both local details and global context, providing a comprehensive semantic anchor for subsequent processing.

### MiA-Emb: Mindscape-Aware Retriever

The retriever component is designed to generate query embeddings that incorporate global context awareness. MiA-Emb addresses two key objectives: selective retrieval (filtering queries to the correct semantic region) and enriched understanding (interpreting queries within broader context).

The training process involves creating a "silver-standard" dataset through automated annotation:

- **Silver Chunk Annotation**: For datasets lacking fine-grained evidence labels, the system uses query augmentation, ensemble retrieval, and LLM-based filtering to identify relevant text chunks.
- **Silver Node Annotation**: A knowledge graph of entities is extracted from documents, and relevant entities are identified for each query.
- **Negative Evidence Construction**: Both hard negatives (semantically similar but incorrect) and simple negatives (randomly sampled) are generated for contrastive learning.

The model optimization employs a residual integration mechanism:

$$
\tilde{q}_t = \alpha \cdot h_{\text{query}} + (1 - \alpha) \cdot h_{\text{task}}
$$

where the final query representation balances the original query intent with global guidance from the mindscape. A joint contrastive loss optimizes both chunk and node retrieval simultaneously.

### MiA-Gen: Mindscape-Aware Generator

The generator component ensures that the reasoning process remains anchored to the global context established during retrieval. MiA-Gen is fine-tuned on a corpus that includes the mindscape summary, retrieved chunks (both relevant and irrelevant), and the query, simulating realistic retrieval conditions.

During inference, MiA-Gen receives the same global context that informed the retrieval process, enabling what the authors call "integrative reasoning" - the ability to interpret retrieved evidence within the broader document context and synthesize coherent responses.

## Experimental Results and Analysis

The evaluation demonstrates consistent improvements across diverse benchmarks, including narrative question answering (NarrativeQA), multiple-choice questions (∞Bench-EN.MC), bilingual detective stories (DetectiveQA), and claim verification (NoCha).

![Performance comparison across different model scales](https://paper-assets.alphaxiv.org/figures/2512.17220v1/img-4.jpeg)

Key findings include:

**Performance Gains**: MiA-RAG achieves substantial improvements, with +16.18% over vanilla 14B baseline and +8.63% over vanilla 72B systems. Notably, a smaller MiA-RAG model (14B) often matches or exceeds the performance of much larger vanilla systems (72B), suggesting that global context awareness is more critical than raw model scale for long-context tasks.

**Efficiency**: The framework demonstrates remarkable efficiency, improving over GPT-4o on challenging benchmarks while using only ~3% of the input tokens. This efficiency stems from the targeted retrieval enabled by global context guidance.

**Component Analysis**: Ablation studies reveal that both MiA-Emb and MiA-Gen contribute significantly to overall performance. Simply providing the mindscape summary to a vanilla generator yields +3.79% improvement, but fine-tuning the generator under the mindscape-conditioning paradigm (MiA-Gen) achieves +11.16% gains.

### Internal Mechanism Analysis

The paper provides detailed analysis of how MiA-RAG internalizes global semantics:

![Embedding space analysis showing selective retrieval](https://paper-assets.alphaxiv.org/figures/2512.17220v1/img-5.jpeg)

**Selective Retrieval**: Geometric analysis shows that MiA-Emb produces query embeddings with smaller projection angles to document semantic subspaces (37.1° vs 43.5° for vanilla models), demonstrating that mindscape conditioning guides queries toward correct semantic regions.

**Enriched Understanding**: Layer-wise attention analysis reveals that MiA-Emb increases attention to the global summary in middle layers, coinciding with improved recall of relevant chunks. The final embedding focuses on summary phrases semantically aligned with the query.

**Integrative Reasoning**: A novel metric, Mindscape-Coherent Evidence Alignment (MCEA), quantifies how MiA-Gen's attention aligns chunks with the summary. MiA-Gen consistently shows higher MCEA values than vanilla models, indicating genuine integration of global semantics into reasoning processes.

## Significance and Contributions

This work makes several important contributions to the field of long-context natural language processing:

**Cognitive-Inspired Framework**: MiA-RAG represents the first computational implementation of "mindscape-aware" capabilities in RAG systems, directly translating human cognitive theories into practical AI architectures.

**Dual-Stage Enhancement**: Unlike previous approaches that focus solely on either retrieval or generation, MiA-RAG provides a comprehensive solution that enhances both stages with consistent global context.

**Efficiency Through Intelligence**: The demonstration that smaller, context-aware models can outperform much larger vanilla systems suggests a paradigm shift from brute-force scaling to intelligent context utilization.

**Broad Applicability**: The consistent improvements across diverse tasks, languages, and domains indicate the framework's general utility for long-context understanding applications.

The research opens new avenues for developing more human-like AI systems that can maintain coherent understanding across extended texts, with potential applications ranging from document analysis and research assistance to complex reasoning tasks requiring synthesis of information from multiple sources.

zh.title: 心智图景感知式检索增强生成，以提升长上下文理解
zh.abstract:
人类理解长篇复杂文本时，依靠的是内容的整体语义表征。这种全局视角有助于组织先验知识、解释新信息，并整合分散在文档中的证据，正如心理学中人类的“心智图感知能力”（Mindscape-Aware Capability）所揭示的那样。当前的检索增强生成（RAG）系统缺乏这种指导，因此难以处理长上下文任务。

在本文中，我们提出了心智图感知RAG (MiA-RAG)，这是首个为基于LLM的RAG系统提供显式全局上下文感知的方法。MiA-RAG通过层次化摘要构建心智图，并将检索和生成都以此全局语义表征为条件。这使得检索器能够形成丰富的查询嵌入，并使生成器能够在连贯的全局上下文中对检索到的证据进行推理。

我们在多样化的长上下文和双语基准上评估了MiA-RAG，这些基准旨在考察基于证据的理解和全局意义构建能力。MiA-RAG持续超越了基线模型，并且进一步分析表明，它能够将局部细节与连贯的全局表征对齐，从而实现更像人类的长上下文检索和推理。

summary.summary: 中国科学院和微信AI的研究人员开发了心境感知RAG（MiA-RAG），将全局语义“心境图”整合到检索和生成中，以实现长文本理解。MiA-RAG在各种基准测试中，相比于普通基线，实现了高达16.18%的绝对性能提升，使得较小的模型能够超越更大规模的传统RAG系统。
originalProblem: 大型语言模型（LLMs）的上下文窗口有限，阻碍了它们处理和理解超长文档的能力。
现有的检索增强生成（RAG）系统主要基于局部证据运行，缺乏对整个文档的整体、全局语义理解。
RAG缺乏“心境感知能力”导致其在整合分散证据和在更广阔文档上下文中解释信息方面存在困难。
solution: 利用两步GPT-4o摘要过程，为每个长文档构建一个分层的“心境图”，以创建全局语义表示。
MiA-Emb，一个心境感知检索器，通过残差连接整合全局心境图来丰富查询嵌入，并通过联合对比优化进行训练。
MiA-Gen，一个心境感知生成器，经过微调以根据全局心境图和检索到的文本块进行生成，从而实现整合推理。
keyInsights: 为RAG系统配备“心境感知能力”（受人类认知启发的全局语义表示）显著增强了长文本理解能力。
将全局语义直接整合到查询表示中，而不仅仅是丰富文档块，能够实现更精确和选择性的检索。
明确地将检索器（MiA-Emb）和生成器（MiA-Gen）都条件化于相同的全局“心境图”，有助于促进连贯的理解和整合推理。
results: MiA-RAG在五个不同的长文本和双语基准测试中始终表现出色，相对于普通的14B模型实现了高达16.18%的绝对增益，相对于普通的72B模型实现了8.63%的绝对增益。
较小的MiA-RAG组件，如MiA-Emb-0.6B和MiA-Gen-14B，匹配或超越了明显更大的普通模型的性能，表明通过全局语义实现了更高的效率和更好的长文本理解。
内部分析证实，MiA-Emb将查询引导至语义相关区域（投影角度为37.1°，而普通模型为43.5°），并且MiA-Gen在整合推理方面表现出更高的心境图一致性证据对齐。

zh.overview:
## 背景与动机

当前检索增强生成（RAG）系统在处理长篇复杂文档时面临一个根本性限制。尽管这些系统可以检索相关的文本块并根据局部证据生成响应，但它们缺乏作者所称的“心智图感知能力”——即人类认知中对整个文档语义结构保持整体理解的能力。当问题需要整合散布在不同章节的信息或理解叙事的全局语境时，这种限制变得尤为突出。

![标准 RAG 和心智图感知 RAG 方法的比较](https://paper-assets.alphaxiv.org/figures/2512.17220v1/img-1.jpeg)

本文引入了心智图感知检索增强生成（MiA-RAG），这是一个明确将全局语义理解融入 RAG 系统检索和生成阶段的框架。MiA-RAG 从图式理论和模糊痕迹理论等心理学理论中汲取灵感，旨在弥合人类认知过程与人工智能系统在长文本理解方面的差距。

## 核心架构与方法

MiA-RAG 包含三个主要组件，它们协同工作以实现全局上下文感知：层次化心智图构建、心智图感知检索器（MiA-Emb）和心智图感知生成器（MiA-Gen）。

### 心智图构建

“心智图”作为整个文档的显式全局记忆表示。它通过使用强大的语言模型（GPT-4o）进行两阶段层次化摘要构建：

1.  **块级摘要**：每个文档块被单独摘要，以创建简洁、重点突出的摘要，保留关键信息同时过滤掉不相关细节。

2.  **全局摘要**：所有块级摘要被连接起来，并进一步浓缩成一个连贯的表示，捕捉文档的总体主题和结构。

这种层次化方法确保心智图既包含局部细节也包含全局上下文，为后续处理提供了全面的语义锚点。

### MiA-Emb：心智图感知检索器

检索器组件旨在生成包含全局上下文感知的查询嵌入。MiA-Emb 解决两个关键目标：选择性检索（将查询过滤到正确的语义区域）和丰富理解（在更广泛的上下文中解释查询）。

训练过程涉及通过自动化标注创建“银标准”数据集：

-   **银块标注**：对于缺乏细粒度证据标签的数据集，系统使用查询增强、集成检索和基于 LLM 的过滤来识别相关的文本块。
-   **银节点标注**：从文档中提取实体知识图谱，并为每个查询识别相关实体。
-   **负面证据构建**：生成硬负例（语义相似但不正确）和简单负例（随机采样）用于对比学习。

模型优化采用残差集成机制：

$$
\tilde{q}_t = \alpha \cdot h_{\text{query}} + (1 - \alpha) \cdot h_{\text{task}}
$$

其中，最终的查询表示平衡了原始查询意图和来自心智图的全局指导。联合对比损失同时优化块和节点检索。

### MiA-Gen：心智图感知生成器

生成器组件确保推理过程始终锚定在检索阶段建立的全局上下文中。MiA-Gen 在包含心智图摘要、检索到的块（相关和不相关）以及查询的语料库上进行微调，模拟真实的检索条件。

在推理过程中，MiA-Gen接收与检索过程相同的全局上下文，从而实现了作者所称的“整合推理”——在更广泛的文档上下文中解释检索到的证据并合成连贯响应的能力。

## 实验结果与分析

评估结果表明，在各种基准测试中都有持续改进，包括叙述性问答（NarrativeQA）、多项选择题（∞Bench-EN.MC）、双语侦探故事（DetectiveQA）和事实核查（NoCha）。

![不同模型规模的性能比较](https://paper-assets.alphaxiv.org/figures/2512.17220v1/img-4.jpeg)

主要发现包括：

**性能提升**：MiA-RAG取得了显著的改进，比普通的14B基线提升了+16.18%，比普通的72B系统提升了+8.63%。值得注意的是，较小的MiA-RAG模型（14B）通常与更大的普通系统（72B）性能持平或超越，这表明对于长上下文任务，全局上下文感知比原始模型规模更为关键。

**效率**：该框架展现出卓越的效率，在具有挑战性的基准测试中优于GPT-4o，而仅使用了约3%的输入令牌。这种效率源于全局上下文引导实现的有针对性检索。

**组件分析**：消融研究表明，MiA-Emb和MiA-Gen都对整体性能有显著贡献。仅向普通生成器提供思维图摘要可带来+3.79%的改进，但在思维图条件范式下（MiA-Gen）微调生成器可实现+11.16%的增益。

### 内部机制分析

该论文详细分析了MiA-RAG如何内化全局语义：

![嵌入空间分析显示选择性检索](https://paper-assets.alphaxiv.org/figures/2512.17220v1/img-5.jpeg)

**选择性检索**：几何分析显示，MiA-Emb生成的查询嵌入与文档语义子空间的投影角度更小（37.1° vs 普通模型的43.5°），这表明思维图条件作用引导查询指向正确的语义区域。

**丰富理解**：层级注意力分析揭示，MiA-Emb增加了中间层对全局摘要的注意力，这与相关块召回率的提高相吻合。最终嵌入专注于与查询语义对齐的摘要短语。

**整合推理**：一项新颖的度量指标——思维图-连贯证据对齐（MCEA），量化了MiA-Gen的注意力如何将块与摘要对齐。MiA-Gen始终显示出比普通模型更高的MCEA值，表明将全局语义真正整合到推理过程中。

## 意义与贡献

这项工作对长上下文自然语言处理领域做出了几项重要贡献：

**认知启发框架**：MiA-RAG代表了RAG系统中“思维图感知”能力的首次计算实现，直接将人类认知理论转化为实用的AI架构。

**双阶段增强**：与以往只关注检索或生成的单一方法不同，MiA-RAG提供了一个全面的解决方案，通过一致的全局上下文增强了两个阶段。

**通过智能实现效率**：较小、上下文感知的模型能够超越大型普通系统的演示表明，范式正在从蛮力扩展转向智能上下文利用。

**广泛适用性**：在各种任务、语言和领域中持续的改进表明该框架对于长上下文理解应用具有普遍实用性。

这项研究为开发更像人类的AI系统开辟了新途径，这些系统能够对长篇文本保持连贯的理解，其潜在应用范围从文档分析和研究辅助，到需要综合多来源信息的复杂推理任务。

abstract: Humans understand long and complex texts by relying on a holistic semantic representation of the content. This global view helps organize prior knowledge, interpret new information, and integrate evidence dispersed across a document, as revealed by the Mindscape-Aware Capability of humans in psychology. Current Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems lack such guidance and therefore struggle with long-context tasks. In this paper, we propose Mindscape-Aware RAG (MiA-RAG), the first approach that equips LLM-based RAG systems with explicit global context awareness. MiA-RAG builds a mindscape through hierarchical summarization and conditions both retrieval and generation on this global semantic representation. This enables the retriever to form enriched query embeddings and the generator to reason over retrieved evidence within a coherent global context. We evaluate MiA-RAG across diverse long-context and bilingual benchmarks for evidence-based understanding and global sense-making. It consistently surpasses baselines, and further analysis shows that it aligns local details with a coherent global representation, enabling more human-like long-context retrieval and reasoning.

abstract: Information retrieval from passive backscatter systems is widely used in digital applications with tight energy budgets, short communication distances, and low data rates. Due to the fundamental limits of classical wireless receivers, the achievable data rate cannot be increased without compromising either energy efficiency or communication range, thereby hindering the broader adoption of this technology. In this work, we present a novel time-resolving quantum receiver combined with a multi-mode probing signal to extract large-alphabet information modulated by a passive reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS). The adaptive nature of the proposed receiver yields significant quantum advantages over classical receivers without relying on complex or fragile quantum resources such as entanglement. Simulation results show that the proposed technique surpasses the classical standard quantum limit (SQL) for modulation sizes up to M = 2^8, meanwhile halving the probing energy or increasing the communication distance by a factor of 1.41.

abstract: Multi-modal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (MMRAG) enables highly credible generation by integrating external multi-modal knowledge, thus demonstrating impressive performance in complex multi-modal scenarios. However, existing MMRAG methods fail to clarify the reasoning logic behind retrieval and response generation, which limits the explainability of the results. To address this gap, we propose to introduce reinforcement learning into multi-modal retrieval-augmented generation, enhancing the reasoning capabilities of multi-modal large language models through a two-stage reinforcement fine-tuning framework to achieve explainable multi-modal retrieval-augmented generation. Specifically, in the first stage, rule-based reinforcement fine-tuning is employed to perform coarse-grained point-wise ranking of multi-modal documents, effectively filtering out those that are significantly irrelevant. In the second stage, reasoning-based reinforcement fine-tuning is utilized to jointly optimize fine-grained list-wise ranking and answer generation, guiding multi-modal large language models to output explainable reasoning logic in the MMRAG process. Our method achieves state-of-the-art results on WebQA and MultimodalQA, two benchmark datasets for multi-modal retrieval-augmented generation, and its effectiveness is validated through comprehensive ablation experiments.

full_text: MMRAG-RFT: Two-stage Reinforcement Fine-tuning for Explainable Multi-modal Retrieval-augmented Generation Multi-modal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (MMRAG) enables highly credible generation by integrating external multi-modal knowledge, thus demonstrating impressive performance in complex multi-modal scenarios. However, existing MMRAG methods fail to clarify the reasoning logic behind retrieval and response generation, which limits the explainability of the results. To address this gap, we propose to introduce reinforcement learning into multi-modal retrieval-augmented generation, enhancing the reasoning capabilities of multi-modal large language models through a two-stage reinforcement fine-tuning framework to achieve explainable multi-modal retrieval-augmented generation. Specifically, in the first stage, rule-based reinforcement fine-tuning is employed to perform coarse-grained point-wise ranking of multi-modal documents, effectively filtering out those that are significantly irrelevant. In the second stage, reasoning-based reinforcement fine-tuning is utilized to jointly optimize fine-grained list-wise ranking and answer generation, guiding multi-modal large language models to output explainable reasoning logic in the MMRAG process. Our method achieves state-of-the-art results on WebQA and MultimodalQA, two benchmark datasets for multi-modal retrieval-augmented generation, and its effectiveness is validated through comprehensive ablation experiments.

abstract: Contrastive Language-Image Pretraining (CLIP) has achieved remarkable performance in various multimodal tasks. However, it still struggles with compositional image-text matching, particularly in accurately associating objects with their corresponding attributes, because its inherent global representation often overlooks fine-grained semantics for attribute binding. Existing methods often require additional training or extensive hard negative sampling, yet they frequently show limited generalization to novel compositional concepts and fail to fundamentally address the drawbacks of global representations. In this paper, we propose ABE-CLIP, a novel training-free Attribute Binding Enhancement method designed to strengthen attribute-object binding in CLIP-like models. Specifically, we employ a Semantic Refinement Mechanism to refine token embeddings for both object and attribute phrases in the text, thereby mitigating attribute confusion and improving semantic precision. We further introduce a Local Token-Patch Alignment strategy that computes similarity scores between refined textual tokens and their most relevant image patches. By aggregating localized similarity scores, ABE-CLIP computes the final image-text similarity. Experiments on multiple datasets demonstrate that ABE-CLIP significantly improves attribute-object binding performance, even surpassing methods that require extensive training.
title: ABE-CLIP: Training-Free Attribute Binding Enhancement for Compositional Image-Text Matching

abstract: Query Expansion (QE) enriches queries and Document Expansion (DE) enriches documents, and these two techniques are often applied separately. However, such separate application may lead to semantic misalignment between the expanded queries (or documents) and their relevant documents (or queries). To address this serious issue, we propose TCDE, a dual expansion strategy that leverages large language models (LLMs) for topic-centric enrichment on both queries and documents. In TCDE, we design two distinct prompt templates for processing each query and document. On the query side, an LLM is guided to identify distinct sub-topics within each query and generate a focused pseudo-document for each sub-topic. On the document side, an LLM is guided to distill each document into a set of core topic sentences. The resulting outputs are used to expand the original query and document. This topic-centric dual expansion process establishes semantic bridges between queries and their relevant documents, enabling better alignment for downstream retrieval models. Experiments on two challenging benchmarks, TREC Deep Learning and BEIR, demonstrate that TCDE achieves substantial improvements over strong state-of-the-art expansion baselines. In particular, on dense retrieval tasks, it outperforms several state-of-the-art methods, with a relative improvement of 2.8\% in NDCG@10 on the SciFact dataset. Experimental results validate the effectiveness of our topic-centric and dual expansion strategy.
title: TCDE: Topic-Centric Dual Expansion of Queries and Documents with Large Language Models for Information Retrieval

abstract: Function calling agents powered by Large Language Models (LLMs) select external tools to automate complex tasks. On-device agents typically use a retrieval module to select relevant tools, improving performance and reducing context length. However, existing retrieval methods rely on static and limited inputs, failing to capture multi-step tool dependencies and evolving task context. This limitation often introduces irrelevant tools that mislead the agent, degrading efficiency and accuracy. We propose Dynamic Tool Dependency Retrieval (DTDR), a lightweight retrieval method that conditions on both the initial query and the evolving execution context. DTDR models tool dependencies from function calling demonstrations, enabling adaptive retrieval as plans unfold. We benchmark DTDR against state-of-the-art retrieval methods across multiple datasets and LLM backbones, evaluating retrieval precision, downstream task accuracy, and computational efficiency. Additionally, we explore strategies to integrate retrieved tools into prompts. Our results show that dynamic tool retrieval improves function calling success rates between $23\%$ and $104\%$ compared to state-of-the-art static retrievers.
title: Dynamic Tool Dependency Retrieval for Efficient Function Calling

abstract:
Encyclopedic knowledge platforms are key gateways through which users explore information online. The recent release of Grokipedia, a fully AI-generated encyclopedia, introduces a new alternative to traditional, well-established platforms like Wikipedia. In this context, search engine mechanisms play an important role in guiding users exploratory paths, yet their behavior across different encyclopedic systems remains underexplored. In this work, we address this gap by providing the first comparative analysis of search engine in Wikipedia and Grokipedia.
  Using nearly 10,000 neutral English words and their substrings as queries, we collect over 70,000 search engine results and examine their semantic alignment, overlap, and topical structure. We find that both platforms frequently generate results that are weakly related to the original query and, in many cases, surface unexpected content starting from innocuous queries. Despite these shared properties, the two systems often produce substantially different recommendation sets for the same query. Through topical annotation and trajectory analysis, we further identify systematic differences in how content categories are surfaced and how search engine results evolve over multiple stages of exploration.
  Overall, our findings show that unexpected search engine outcomes are a common feature of both the platforms, even though they exhibit discrepancies in terms of topical distribution and query suggestions.
title: Unexpected Knowledge: Auditing Wikipedia and Grokipedia Search Recommendations

abstract: Similarity-based collaborative filtering (CF) models have long demonstrated strong offline performance and conceptual simplicity. However, their scalability is limited by the quadratic cost of maintaining dense item-item similarity matrices. Partitioning-based paradigms have recently emerged as an effective strategy for balancing effectiveness and efficiency, enabling models to learn local similarities within coherent subgraphs while maintaining a limited global context. In this work, we focus on the Fine-tuning Partition-aware Similarity Refinement (FPSR) framework, a prominent representative of this family, as well as its extension, FPSR+. Reproducible evaluation of partition-aware collaborative filtering remains challenging, as prior FPSR/FPSR+ reports often rely on splits of unclear provenance and omit some similarity-based baselines, thereby complicating fair comparison. We present a transparent, fully reproducible benchmark of FPSR and FPSR+. Based on our results, the family of FPSR models does not consistently perform at the highest level. Overall, it remains competitive, validates its design choices, and shows significant advantages in long-tail scenarios. This highlights the accuracy-coverage trade-offs resulting from partitioning, global components, and hub design. Our investigation clarifies when partition-aware similarity modeling is most beneficial and offers actionable guidance for scalable recommender system design under reproducible protocols.
title: A Reproducible and Fair Evaluation of Partition-aware Collaborative Filtering
